senses.gloss: प्रिय- + अर्ह प्रिय- + अर्ह, adj. deserving love, amiable, Kir. 5, 51.
प्रीत- + आत्मन् प्रीत- + आत्मन्, adj. with an affectionate mind, Man. 1, 60.
प्रिय- + काम प्रिय- + काम, adj. benevolent, Brāhmaṇ. 2, 23.
प्रिय- + धन्व प्रिय- + धन्व, adj. bow-loving, MBh. 7, 9596.
प्रीति-पुरोग प्रीति-पुरोग, adj. accompanied by love, friendly, MBh. 12, 10935.
प्रिय- + प्राय प्रिय- + प्राय, adj. very kind.

प्रिय प्रिय, i. e. प्री + अ,
 I. adj., f. या, comparat. प्रियतर and प्रेयंस्, superl. प्रियतम and प्रेष्ठ, Beloved, dear, Pañc. i. d. 205; agreeable, Śāk. 112, 15. प्रेयंस्, Much beloved, Kathās. 26, 283; Lass. 68, 4.
 II. m.
 1. A husband, Bhāg. P. 4, 3, 6.
 2. A lover, Pañc. i. d. 205.
 3. A sort of deer.
 4. A sort of drug.
 III. f. A wife or mistress.
 IV. n.
 1. Love, Rājat. 5, 47; sake, Chr. 22, 18.
 2. A service, Vikr. 11, 18.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ϕίλος, ϕιλίων; Lat. filius.
प्रियाप्रिय प्रियाप्रिय, i. e. प्रिय-अ-, adj. agreeable and disagreeable, Hit. i. d. 11.

प्रियंवद प्रियंवद, i. e. प्रिय + म्-वद् + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Speaking what is agreeable, Hit. iii. d. 103.
 2. Sweet speaking, Indr. 4, 11.
 II. m. A proper name, Ragh. 3, 53.
 III. f. दा, A proper name, Śāk. 10, 15.

प्रियक प्रिय + क, m.
 1. The name of several plants.
 2. A kind of deer.
 3. A bee.
 4. A certain bird, MBh. 3, 11576.

प्रियकार प्रिय-कार, and प्रियंकर प्रियंकर, i. e. प्रिय + म्-कर, adj.
 1. Acting kindly, Sund. 1, 5.
 2. Amiable.
प्रियकृत् प्रिय-कृ + त्, adj. sbst. Doing a kindness, a friend, Johns. Sel. 18, 80.
प्रियंकर प्रियंकर, see प्रियकार.

प्रियंगु प्रियंगु, m.
 1. A medicinal plant and perfume.
 2. Panick seed, Panicum italicum.
 3. Black mustard seed.
 4. Long pepper.

प्रियता प्रिय + ता, f.
 1. Being beloved, Man. 5, 50.
 2. Love, Rājat. 5, 351.
प्रियाल प्रियाल (akin to प्रिय), m. A tree, commonly Piyal.

प्री प्री, ii. 9, प्रीणा, प्रीणी. and i. 1: † i. 10, Par. Ātm.
 1. To please to [] delight, Bhartṛ. 2, 71; Rājat. 5, 280.
 2. † To love. Pass. and i. 4, Ātm. (properly pass.),
 1. To be pleased, MBh. 1, 1070; with the termination of the Par., MBh. 3, 15025 (and loc.).
 2. To be satisfied, to assent, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 19.
 3. To love, Rām. 6, 10, 23.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. प्रीत.
 1. Beloved, Rām. 3, 49, 11.
 2. Pleased, delighted, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 21.
 3. Satisfied, Chr. 28, 17.
 4. Kind.
 II. प्रीण,
 --Comp.
 --Caus. प्रीणय (properly a denomin. derived from प्रीण), To delight, MBh. 1, 6414. प्रीणित, Pleased, Pañc. 198, 21.
 --With the prep. सम् सम्, i. 4, Ātm. To be pleased, Rām. 2, 45, 22 Gorr. (= Schl. 2, 48, 18, where erroneously प्रियेत with short इ).
 --Cf. ἐϕιλάμην, प्रिय and प्रीति; Goth. frijon, frijônds, friathva, freis; A.S. fréfrian, freónd, freo, frio, frige, fridh.

प्रीति प्री + ति, f.
 1. Joy, Pañc. ii. d. 71; gratification, Hit. i. d. 96, M.M.
 2. Love, Pañc. i. d. 317; Kathās. 99, 100.
 3. Peaceable way, Pañc. i. d. 421.
 4. The wife of Kāma, or Cupid.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. A.S. fridh, fredho; O.H.G. fridu.

प्रीतिमन्त् प्रीति + मन्त्, adj., f. मती.
 1. Affectionate, Lass. 66, 1.
 2. Joyful, Chr. 60, 30.
 3. Content, voluntary, Chr. 6, 7.
प्रीति- + मनस् प्रीति- + मनस्, adj. pleased in mind.
प्रिय- + रण प्रिय- + रण, adj. delighting in war.
प्रिय- + वचन प्रिय- + वचन, n. word of love, Vikr. d. 40.
प्रिय- + वादिन् प्रिय- + वादिन्, adj. speaking agreeably, as one wishes, Pañc. ii. d. 171; Hit. pr. d. 19, M.M.
